checks.statement: the paired spin symbol determinant is positive off zero
the scalar magnetic presentation has four characteristic lines
all four ridge directions solve the projected equation
multiplying a ridge by a transverse cutoff creates a source
the characteristic support is a finite union of codimension-one lines
global bundle gluing leaves only smooth l=2,3,4 modes

checks.detail: Paley-Wiener: entire Fourier transform vanishes on open complement
checks.statement: compactly supported homogeneous projected solutions vanish

verdict: The paired global operator is elliptic, whereas p^4-q^4 is a nonelliptic coordinate projection with four ridge-wave families. No nonzero projected solution is both compactly supported or L2 on the plane, and global spin/parity gluing leaves only smooth l=2,3,4 modes.
